question.text: How much will Nvidia's stock price returns exceed Microsoft's in these biweekly periods of Q4 2026? (Nov 9 - Nov 20)
question.resolution_criteria:
Each subquestion will resolve as the difference between the percent stock price return of [NVDA](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA/history/) and that of [MSFT](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/MSFT/history/) for the corresponding biweekly period, according to Yahoo Finance data.

Specifically, each subquestion will resolve as NVDA\_return - MSFT\_return.

Returns will be calculated as follows: If P₀ is the Adj Close price of a company stock on the last trading day or half-day *before* the start of the period and P₁ is the Adj Close price of the stock on the last trading day *of* the designated period, the percentage return will be calculated as:

$$
 \text{return} = 100 \times \frac{P1 - P0}{P0}
$$
question.fine_print:
* If Microsoft outperforms Nvidia, the corresponding subquestion will resolve as a negative number.
* If Yahoo Finance delays or ceases reporting these data or if it reports them in error, Metaculus might use alternative credible sources to resolve this question.
* Resolutions are based on the prices at the market close on the last trading day of the designated period. Further adjustments to Adj Close prices after that will not cause subquestions to re-resolve.

***

For example, for the period Jun 9, 2025 - Jun 20, 2025, the subquestion would resolve based on the following calculations:

NVDA\_P₀ \= 141.71 (the Adj Close price on Jun 6)

NVDA\_P₁ \= 143.85 (the Close price on Jun 20)

NVDA\_return \= 100 × (143.85 - 141.71) / 141.71 \= 1.510

MSFT\_P₀ \= 470.38 (the Adj Close price on Jun 6)

MSFT\_P₁ \= 477.40 (the Close price on Jun 20)

MSFT\_return \= 100 × (477.40 - 470.38) / 470.38 \= 1.4924

And the resolution would be 1.510 - 1.494 \= **0.016** percentage points (pp).

research:
I couldn't find anything that settles this question or nearly settles it. The starting prices are the Nov 6 closes, which don't exist yet. The big scheduled event is Nvidia's quarterly earnings after the close on Nov 17, which falls inside the period. Nvidia closed Oct 30 near a three-month low after an AI-spending sell-off in tech stocks, and past periods containing an earnings report have produced large spreads.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-02: Yahoo's NVDA history page shows an Oct 30 close and Adj Close of 204.64, and 206.61 intraday on Nov 2 while the market was still open. [Yahoo NVDA](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA/history/)
- 2026-11-02: Yahoo's MSFT page shows 521.91 on Oct 30 and 520.84 intraday on Nov 2. [Yahoo MSFT](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/MSFT/history/)
- The starting price (P₀) will be the Nov 6 Adj Close and the ending price (P₁) the Nov 20 close. Microsoft goes ex-dividend inside the period (next bullet). Once that happens, Yahoo lowers MSFT's Nov 6 Adj Close, which adds roughly 0.19pp to MSFT's return and takes about the same amount off the NVDA minus MSFT result.
- 2025-09-15 (release date): Microsoft's dividend is $0.98 a share, with ex-dividend and record dates of Nov 19, 2026. [Placera/Microsoft PR](https://www.placera.se/pressmeddelanden/microsoft-announces-quarterly-dividend-increase-20260916)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing is settled yet. Recent moves: NVDA went from 221.97 on Oct 21 to 204.64 on Oct 30, about -7.8%. MSFT went from 532.95 to 521.91 over the same days, about -2.1%. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NVDA/history/)

## 4. Base rates
Past resolutions of this question series, from the organizers' spreadsheet ([sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1C_AmOdivYdNuCnEn-I_ps2TJkCAVQkyKOirvhK2jZ2I/edit?gid=0#gid=0)):
- **Last ~32 two-week periods:** the median is about 0pp, the mean is slightly negative, and the typical absolute value is about 3pp. Fat tails: -22.71 (Jul 24 to Aug 7, 2026, likely Microsoft's 16% post-earnings jump), -13.24, +11.74, +10.51, +9.06.
- **Recent values:** -6.02 (Oct 9 to 23), -1.35 (Oct 23 period, provisional), 0.45, -2.22, 3.88, -0.96. Microsoft has been outperforming lately.
- **Periods containing Nvidia earnings:**
  - Nov 7 to 21, 2025: -0.13
  - Aug 21 to Sep 4, 2026: +3.88
  - May 15 to 29, 2026: -13.24 (by date, this probably contained a May 2026 Nvidia report; not verified)
- **Computed baseline for NVDA alone over 12 trading days:**
  - The 5th to 95th percentile range runs from about -9.5% to +17.8% from 206.57. That wide range comes from the history it uses, not from this period's news.
  - The 25th to 75th percentile range is about -3.6% to +7.7%.
  - MSFT's volatility is lower, so the spread mostly reflects NVDA's moves.

## 5. Other forecasts

- Related markets:

  - Polymarket's "biggest single-day Mag 7 move in 2026" market has NVDA at 0.415 and MSFT at 0.405.
  - Neither is directly useful here.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-11-06: The Nov 6 closes set P₀, so the moves this week (Apple earnings and macro news) are not part of the result.
- 2026-11-17: Nvidia reports after the close, with written CFO commentary around 4:20 pm ET and the call at 5 pm ET. The quarter ended Oct 25. This gives two full trading sessions (Nov 18 to 20) to react. [StockTitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/news/NVDA/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-third-quarter-financial-rgdf7hquxgar.html)

- Ongoing: the debate over AI spending and profitability after the Intel, Amazon and Alphabet results. News also mentions expectations of a rate hike, which I did not verify. Fed and macro releases in mid-November could also move the stocks.
- Nvidia's own dividend ($0.01) has an effect too small to matter.

## 4. Base rates

With a high NVDA/MSFT correlation (about 0.5-0.6), I estimate the two-week NVDA-MSFT spread has a standard deviation of roughly 5-7pp. That is my rough estimate, not computed from data. Two-week windows that include NVDA earnings tend to sit at the wide end.
- Recent realized spread: in October NVDA underperformed MSFT by about 12pp over four weeks. Over Oct 16-30, NVDA went 214.13→204.64 (-4.4%) while MSFT went 529.05→521.91 (-1.3%), a spread of about -3.1pp.
- I could not load the past resolutions in the Metaculus Google Sheet.
- Past NVDA earnings reactions have been mixed: November 2025 saw an initial pop that then reversed into a decline the next day. The earnings move is the dominant single risk in this window.
